Any restrictions on deployment arise from biometric privacy regulations (GDPR/BIPA) and unverified subject consent, NOT from the copyright terms of the MIT license.
provenance_audit.training_data_overlap_status: UNVERIFIED (Overlap with FaceForensics++ training videos cannot be ruled out without biometric donor-target verification)

metric_audit.pr_auc_methodology_disclosure: The reported PR-AUC (0.7582) is calculated via trapezoidal numerical integration along the precision-recall curve. Average Precision (AP), which weights precision by recall steps, yields 0.7604. Both metrics are mathematically valid but represent distinct integral formulations and are not interchangeable.
metric_audit.tied_score_handling: Unique probability thresholds are grouped; samples with identical continuous fake probabilities evaluate under identical thresholding.
metric_audit.missing_prediction_handling: Failed face detections are appended to face_detection_failures and not imputed with synthetic probabilities (0 failures occurred in this 100-sample benchmark).
